caption: The drawing depicts an interior wall of a room with three main architectural elements: a window on the left, a central wooden door, and a niche or built-in shelf on the right. The wall is off-white or beige with subtle texturing and outlined by arch-like contours highlighted in light blue. The window has wooden shutters and a decorative iron grill, and is bordered with a reddish-brown accent. The door is made of wooden planks with visible grain and metal hinges. The niche or shelf on the right is rectangular, featuring a glass or translucent cover with a swirling red and blue pattern. A band of blue with a stylized floral motif runs horizontally along the bottom section of the wall, and a matching, narrower floral border is present near the ceiling. The tile floor is light brown with a reddish tint, laid out in a diagonal pattern. The ceiling is made of wooden beams and crossbeams, with a blue and red decorative cornice running along the domed top edges of the walls. A simple outlined floral medallion is present above the door on the wall.
title: Wall Painting (Door)
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
